subject: Starter alignment: goals, owners, timeline
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Perez <sofia.perez@medisys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Starter alignment: goals, owners, timeline

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for taking time last week. I wanted to share a short starter MAP (attached) to make the first 4–8 weeks very concrete so we can move into an evaluation quickly. Goal here is to confirm:

- the top 2 success criteria you want to validate during the pilot (e.g., 95% intent accuracy on triage flows, sub-200ms P95 inference latency),
- primary champion + who will own day-to-day testing, and
- a target close/pilot kickoff window.

High-level proposal in the attachment: 6-week evaluation & decision runway, weekly checkpoints, and a short technical onboarding session in week 1. Marissa (CC’d) would own onboarding and ensure we have the evaluation dataset and test harness ready. I’ll own the commercial timeline and mutual action items.

Proposed next steps:
1) Can you confirm your two priority success criteria and primary stakeholders?
2) Is a May 20th kickoff call at 10:00 AM PT reasonable for your team?
3) Any procurement or legal leads to loop in now?

I attached a draft MAP and a short list of Medisys questions we typically ask (quick XLS). If helpful I can send a pared-down one-page version for execs.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: REDWOOD-MAP-DRAFT.pdf (application/pdf), Medisys-Questions.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Sofia Perez <sofia.perez@medisys.com>

Subject: Re: Starter alignment: goals, owners, timeline

Thanks, Aditya — this is helpful. Confirming a few things from our side:

- Success criteria: 1) Reduce triage routing errors by 40% on the 30-day test set; 2) Average inference latency under 200ms at expected concurrency.
- Champion: I’ll be the product champion and own prioritization. Technical owner: Rebecca Lin (CTO) for integration and infra. Procurement lead: Carlos Medina (CC’d) for contract and billing.
- Timeline: Kickoff on Thu May 21 at 10:00 AM PT works better for our schedules; target pilot start the week of June 7 and evaluation complete by July 16.

Also attaching a short list of internal constraints (security scans and data retention policy) — we’ll share that after the kickoff. Quick Q: will Redwood require any customer-provided sample traffic, or can Marissa help validate with synthetic/test data initially?

Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starter alignment: goals, owners, timeline

Great — thanks for the clarity, Sofia.

Confirming new plan and owners:
- Champion / product: Sofia Perez (Medisys)
- Technical owner: Rebecca Lin (Medisys)
- Procurement / billing: Carlos Medina (Medisys)
- Redwood owners: Aditya (AE) for commercial cadence; Marissa (CS) for onboarding & test harness.

I updated the MAP (attached) with the June 7 pilot start and a weekly checkpoint cadence (weeks 1/2/3/4 then exec review). I also added two quick acceptance tests mapped to your success criteria so we can instrument them during onboarding.

To your question — Marissa can validate with synthetic/test data initially; for the final acceptance test we will want a sample of production-like traffic (anonymized) to confirm real-world latency and routing accuracy. We will list required artifacts in the onboarding checklist (dataset format, sample size, access method).

Confirmed kickoff: Thu May 21, 10:00 AM PT — I’ll send a calendar invite in a minute. Agenda: introductions, success criteria review, quick infra checklist, and next steps for procurement.

Forwarding the MAP to PrIyom for visibility and a quick ask on a short trial credit we typically provision for pilots — details below.

Thanks — see you on the call.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Attachments: REDWOOD-MAP-DRAFT-v2.pdf (application/pdf)

Priyom — forwarding the thread for visibility. Quick summary: Medisys (Sofia) confirmed success criteria and stakeholders; kickoff Thu May 21 10:00 AM PT; pilot target start June 7 and evaluation complete mid-July.

Request: would you OK a standard pilot credit of $3,000 for evaluation compute & priority onboarding? We typically grant this for pilots that hit X expected token volume; I’ll add expected token estimate in the follow-up. If fine I’ll queue the credit so CS can schedule earlier slots.
